[ATM3 — acid purification] The unchanged Chemical Washer operation uses one unit dirty ATM slurry and 1 mB existing TFMG sulfuric-acid FLUID to produce one unit clean ATM slurry. Run 2,400 native operations per full batch, consuming 2,400 mB acid and preserving 12 feed-equivalent units. The acid fluid remains distinct from Mekanism sulfuric-acid chemical. No per-operation bill, machine or review decision changes here.

[ATM4 — crystal growth] The unchanged native ratio is 200 units clean Allthemodium slurry -> one Allthemodium crystal. Run 12 operations for the 2,400-unit batch. These crystals go to the existing Create Crushing Wheels step for clean dust; they do not return to dirty feedstock. Only this batch explanation changes.

[ATM5 — crystal comminution] The unchanged Create Crushing Wheels operation converts one purified Allthemodium crystal -> one clean Allthemodium dust. Run 12 operations for this batch. Machine selection is context, not a consumed ingredient. Retain duration250; real time/stress depend on rotation speed. No clump/shard/dirty-dust detour, yield multiplier or alternate ingot output.

[ATM6 — clean-dust refining] Consume all 12 clean Allthemodium dust with the retained five Fluorite Dust and 100 mB Liquid Helium in one Fireproof Vat with three Graphite Electrodes. Produce 90 mB molten Allthemodium, 990 mB molten slag and 1,000 mB Hot Helium. Retain 6,000 eligible ticks, superheat, heatLevel4 and 27-block body. At the existing90mB-per-feed accounting this is one ATM-equivalent plus11slag-equivalents. Combined early solids:14feed units ->1graphite+1solid slag+11molten-slag equivalents+1ATM-equivalent. Late Radiance/redstone conditioning products and flux/acid/HCl/coolant are separately accounted reagents. The user-created Radiance PRC can condition this molten output into raw stock; its original bill is preserved.

[ATM7/8 — cast unpolarized stock] Cast the one90mB Allthemodium batch into one existing RAW Allthemodium item using the retained Modern Foundry ingot cast. Native cast_consumed=false preserves the cast; this does not consume and recreate a possibly damaged tool. Raw is the user-selected unpolarized stock form, not a second ore source.
